entries.note: Construction sites, closures and signed diversion routes on Schleswig-Holstein's roads and motorways, plus current traffic disruptions. Also carries the roadworks of Hamburg, Lower Saxony and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

entries.note: Construction sites on Hamburg's roads.

entries.note: Current traffic flow on Hamburg's main roads.

entries.name: Hamburg — police traffic reports
entries.note: The police's current traffic reports for Hamburg: accidents, closures and hazards.

entries.note: Current and upcoming roadworks and closures on federal, state and district roads in Brandenburg.

entries.name: BKG — topographic 1:100 000
entries.note: Topographic map of the whole country at 1:100 000.

entries.name: Baden-Württemberg — topographic 1:25 000
entries.note: The state's 1:25 000 sheet. Enough detail for small roads and tracks.

entries.name: Baden-Württemberg — road map 1:200 000
entries.note: The official road map of the state, for reading a route at low zoom.

entries.name: Baden-Württemberg — aerial imagery
entries.note: 20 cm colour aerial photography of the whole state.

entries.name: Baden-Württemberg — hillshade
entries.note: Terrain shading from the laser-scan height model, for reading relief under another layer.

entries.name: Baden-Württemberg — protected areas
entries.note: Nature reserves, national park and biosphere zones, where access is often restricted.

entries.name: Baden-Württemberg — world heritage sites
entries.note: UNESCO sites in the state, including the Roman Limes, Reichenau and the ice-age caves.

entries.name: Baden-Württemberg — archaeological sites
entries.note: Recorded archaeological monuments — forts, burial grounds, earthworks.

entries.name: Baden-Württemberg — geotopes and landmarks
entries.note: Caves, waterfalls, gorges, rock formations and viewpoints, as places worth stopping at.

entries.name: Baden-Württemberg — geological hazards
entries.note: Where rockfall, landslide and sinkholes are known to occur.

entries.name: Baden-Württemberg — flood zones
entries.note: Designated flood areas along the state's rivers.

entries.name: Karlsruhe region — traffic and roadworks
entries.note: Current and planned roadworks, one-way streets, ferries, low-emission zones, winter gritting and motorcycle parking. Karlsruhe region only.

entries.name: PDOK — topographic basemap
entries.note: National basemap, several styles.

entries.name: PDOK — aerial imagery
entries.note: Recent aerial photography.

entries.name: Kartverket
entries.note: Topographic and nautical raster maps.

entries.name: Poland — forest ownership
entries.note: Who owns each forest: State Forests, national parks, communal or private, from the national Forest Data Bank.

entries.name: Poland — forest compartments
entries.note: Forest compartment lines and numbers, and the forest-district boundaries, as posted on the marker stones in State Forests.

entries.name: DGT — aerial imagery 2018
entries.note: Aerial photography of Portugal, flown in 2018.

entries.name: IGN — PNOA aerial imagery
entries.note: National aerial photography.

entries.name: IGN — raster map
entries.note: Scanned topographic maps of Spain.

entries.name: swisstopo
entries.note: National maps, imagery and thematic layers.

entries.name: swisstopo — National Map tiles
entries.note: The national topographic map as Web Mercator tiles.

entries.name: Environment Agency — LiDAR terrain
entries.note: Ground height at 1 m detail, from laser scanning.

entries.name: USFS — Motor Vehicle Use Map
entries.note: Which roads and trails in US National Forests are open to motor vehicles.

entries.name: USFS — forest roads
entries.note: The Forest Service road network in every National Forest, appearing from zoom 11.

entries.name: USFS — forest trails
entries.note: Forest Service trails in every National Forest, appearing from zoom 11.

entries.name: USFS — campgrounds and trailheads
entries.note: Campgrounds, trailheads, picnic sites and other Forest Service recreation sites, appearing from zoom 11.

entries.name: USFS — wilderness areas
entries.note: Designated wilderness areas, where no motor vehicle may go, at every zoom.

entries.name: BLM — roads and trails
entries.note: Roads and trails on Bureau of Land Management land, split by whether motor vehicles are allowed on them.

entries.name: BLM — campgrounds and recreation sites
entries.note: Campgrounds, boat ramps, day-use areas and other recreation sites on Bureau of Land Management land.

entries.name: BLM — land managers
entries.note: Public land coloured by the agency that manages its surface: Bureau of Land Management, Forest Service, Park Service, Fish and Wildlife Service, Reclamation, Indian Affairs, military, state and local. Private land is left blank. Served as cached tiles, so it appears quickly.

entries.name: BLM — wilderness and wilderness study areas
entries.note: Wilderness and wilderness study areas on Bureau of Land Management land. Wilderness is closed to motor vehicles; in study areas they are limited to the routes the BLM allows.

entries.name: NPS — park roads
entries.note: Public roads in national parks and other National Park Service units.

entries.name: NPS — park trails
entries.note: Public trails in national parks and other National Park Service units; trails closed to the public are left out.

entries.name: USGS — mines and mineral resources
entries.note: Mines, prospects and mineral occurrences from the USGS Mineral Resource Data System, which the USGS no longer updates.

entries.name: USGS — aerial imagery
entries.note: National aerial imagery.

entries.name: USGS — shaded relief
entries.note: Terrain shading.

entries.name: USGS — hydrography
entries.note: Rivers, lakes and coastline.

entries.name: USGS — protected areas by manager (PAD-US 4.1)
entries.note: Who manages each protected area, from the current edition of the database — Forest Service, Bureau of Land Management, National Park Service, state, local, tribal or private. Drawn fresh for each view, so it takes a moment longer to appear.

entries.name: USGS — contours
entries.note: Topographic contour lines for the United States at multiple scales.

entries.name: USGS — NHD hydrography (detailed)
entries.note: Individual stream reaches, named water bodies, canals, drainage basins and other features from the National Hydrography Dataset. More detail than the cached hydrography basemap.

entries.name: NLCD — land cover
entries.note: What the land is covered with across the contiguous US and Alaska: forest, shrub, grassland, wetland, cultivated and urban, at 30 m resolution. Multiple editions of the National Land Cover Database.

entries.name: USFWS — National Wetlands Inventory
entries.note: Wetlands mapped by the US Fish & Wildlife Service: marshes, swamps, bogs, ponds and coastal waters. Useful for assessing trafficability in soft or seasonally flooded terrain.

entries.name: EPA — ecoregions
entries.note: Level III and IV ecoregions — areas where ecosystems, vegetation, soils and land use are broadly similar. Useful as context when interpreting terrain and vegetation layers.

entries.name: NOAA — snow analysis
entries.note: Daily snow water equivalent and snow depth from the NOAA National Operational Hydrologic Remote Sensing Center. Useful for planning winter access.

entries.name: USFS — fire history
entries.note: Wildfire occurrence points and perimeters in US National Forests since the 1970s. Useful for understanding which areas have burned and assessing post-fire terrain.

entries.name: USFS — fire, current edition
entries.note: The most recently published compilation of wildfire occurrences in National Forests. More current than the historical archive but otherwise covers the same data.

entries.name: USFS — fire severity (MTBS)
entries.note: How intensely each large wildfire burned, derived from satellite imagery, since 1984. From the Monitoring Trends in Burn Severity program. Useful for assessing vegetation recovery and post-fire trafficability.

entries.name: USFS — fireshed registry
entries.note: Firesheds and their treatment priority across the contiguous US — areas where prescribed burning and fuel reduction are planned or in progress.

entries.name: USGS — governmental unit boundaries
entries.note: Outlines and names of national forests, wilderness areas, parks, monuments, Bureau of Land Management and tribal lands, and state, county and town limits. Names are separate layers: pick a boundary and its label together.

entries.name: US Census — boundaries (TIGERweb)
entries.note: State, county, city and tribal-land boundaries with their names, from the Census Bureau, alongside the statistical areas it draws for its own counts.

entries.name: USGS — 3DEP elevation
entries.note: Elevation, slope and hillshade.

entries.name: NOAA nowCOAST
entries.note: Weather, radar and marine observations.

entries.name: NOAA — nautical charts
entries.note: Electronic navigational charts.

entries.name: NEXRAD radar
entries.note: Live and archived precipitation radar.

entries.name: LANDFIRE — vegetation and fuels
entries.note: Vegetation type, height and cover across the contiguous US.

entries.name: WFIGS — current wildfire perimeters
entries.note: Perimeters of active wildfires, as vector features queried by view.

entries.name: USGS — topographic map
entries.note: The National Map's topographic base map, cached tiles.

entries.name: USGS — protected areas by fee manager (PAD-US 4.1)
entries.note: Who owns or manages each protected area, as polygons drawn in the browser; the same data as the PAD-US map service.

entries.name: BTS — North American rail network lines
entries.note: Every rail line in the United States, Canada and Mexico, with owner, track rights and use (NTAD).

entries.name: BTS — North American rail network nodes
entries.note: Junctions and ends of the rail network lines (NTAD).

entries.name: BTS — passenger rail lines
entries.note: The rail network lines that carry passenger trains (NTAD).

entries.name: BTS — Amtrak routes
entries.note: Amtrak's passenger routes as lines.

entries.name: BTS — Amtrak stations
entries.note: Amtrak stations and stops.

entries.name: BTS — railroad grade crossings
entries.note: Every place a road or path crosses a railway, from the FRA crossing inventory.

entries.name: BTS — railroad bridges
entries.note: Railroad bridges, as points.

entries.name: BTS — rail yards
entries.note: The tracks of rail yards, as lines.

entries.name: HIFLD — electric power transmission lines
entries.note: High-voltage transmission lines with their voltage and owner. HIFLD has archived the layer: it is no longer updated.

entries.name: EPA AirNow — air quality index
entries.note: Contours of the latest air quality index, ozone and fine particles combined, in the AQI colours from green (good) to maroon (hazardous).

entries.name: EPA AirNow — fine particles (PM2.5)
entries.note: Contours of the latest air quality index for fine particles (PM2.5), the pollutant wildfire smoke raises, in the AQI colours.

entries.name: EPA AirNow — ozone
entries.note: Contours of the latest air quality index for ozone, in the AQI colours.

entries.name: EPA AirNow — monitoring stations
entries.note: The latest readings of the stations measuring ozone and particles, each dot in the colour of its air quality index.

entries.name: EPA AirNow — air quality forecast
entries.note: Today's and tomorrow's air quality forecast for each reporting area, in the AQI colours.

entries.name: NOAA — wildfire smoke forecast
entries.note: Near-surface smoke from wildfires, from NOAA air quality forecast guidance that runs about two days ahead. The map shows the hour the service shows by default.

entries.name: Baden-Württemberg — MobiData BW (WFS)
entries.note: Roadworks, charging points, bike parking, sharing vehicles, stops and stations as features, from zoom 9.

entries.name: Karlsruhe region — traffic and roadworks (WFS)
entries.note: The roadworks and traffic layers of the Karlsruhe WMS as features, from zoom 9.

entries.name: Motorcycle road closures
entries.note: Roads closed to motorcycles on certain days or hours in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the Netherlands and Belgium, collected by mintelonline.de. Its server does not let web pages read the file: download it with the arrow, then choose it here. Updated every few weeks; Replace in the layer's settings takes a newer download.

entries.name: DWD — weather observations and warnings (WFS)
entries.note: Station observations and warning areas of the Deutscher Wetterdienst as features.

entries.name: France — Sandre water reference data (WFS)
entries.note: Rivers, catchments, monitoring stations and water bodies; several hundred feature types.

entries.name: North Rhine-Westphalia — hospitals (OGC API)
entries.note: Hospitals of North Rhine-Westphalia from an OGC API – Features service.

entries.name: Berlin — the Berlin Wall, 1989
entries.note: The GDR border installations as traced from an aerial photo of 25 April 1989: border wall, rear wall or fence, border strip, with the photo itself.

entries.name: Berlin — the Berlin Wall, 1989 (WFS)
entries.note: The walls, the border strip and the political border as features, to colour and tap.

entries.name: BKG — GDR topographic map 1:200 000
entries.note: Last editions of the GDR map, 1974–1989: the restricted edition for state and army (Ausgabe Staat) and the public one (Ausgabe für die Volkswirtschaft).

entries.name: Brandenburg — Reich topographic map 1:25 000
entries.note: Messtischblätter of Brandenburg and Berlin, first surveyed from 1875; many sheets were updated in the 1930s and 1940s.

entries.name: North Rhine-Westphalia — topographic 1:25 000, 1936–1945
entries.note: The state's map sheets as updated from 1936 to 1945; drawn only when zoomed in closely.

entries.name: Rhineland-Palatinate — topographic 1:25 000, 1887–2024
entries.note: Every edition of the state's map sheets; choose the year in the layer's settings, which starts at 2024. Which years a sheet has varies: around Dahn the first is 1937.

entries.name: Rhineland-Palatinate — Palatinate survey, 1836–1841
entries.note: The original 1:25 000 survey sheets of the Palatinate, then part of the Kingdom of Bavaria.

entries.name: Rhineland-Palatinate — aerial photos since 1994
entries.note: One layer per year from 1994; each year shows the part of the state flown that year, so a place appears every two to three years.

entries.name: Saxony — historical maps 1:25 000
entries.note: Messtischblatt before 1945, the GDR's restricted state edition of 1976–1989, and the map from 1990.

entries.name: Bavaria — monuments
entries.note: Listed buildings, archaeological sites and ensembles of the Bavarian monument list, updated daily.

entries.name: Saxony — cultural monuments and protected areas
entries.note: Cultural monuments as points, lines and areas, beside the state's nature reserves and protected landscapes.

entries.name: VersaTiles — vector tile layers
entries.note: OpenStreetMap in the Shortbread schema, each tile layer a layer of its own in one colour.
